_comment: Reviewed Edge candidate identities (D-384, 2026-11-26): per function, the manifest sha256 of a reviewed source graph and the class it was reviewed as. A source whose manifest is not here is UNKNOWN and refused by both deploy gates; one whose source reads as another class is CONFLICTING and refused. Every entry is verified by tests/unit/edge-deploy-gate.test.mjs from `verified_by`: 'tree' = this checkout's source, 'fixture:634b7282' = tests/fixtures/edge-gate-before-f8-634b7282.json. A change to a function's graph (including supabase/functions/_shared) changes its manifest: review it, then replace the 'tree' entry (node tools/edge/edge-deploy-gate.mjs identity prints it).
